Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class FacilityConstraints

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.FacilityConstraints
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class FacilityConstraints extends Object implements Serializable
Handling capacities of the receiving facility, used to hold wells back when the network can deliver more than the facility can take.

A capacity that is not set is unlimited. Rates are surface volumes in Sm3/day.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
